column1: # One line per hand-written single-field newtype over a primitive the census reads, ambre-spec-newtypes.md
# section 1, with the reason no generic family of ambre-core fits it. Add a line by hand only; a reviewer reads it.

column2: reason
one emoji as the view picked it, borrowed from a 'static table with no allocation, or owned off the wire. Every text family of core owns a String, and the engine rules on the value

a sealed segment with a layout of its own: key_id, split and from_parts read and build it, and they would have to move into core. Its serde is the derived Vec<u8>, which the base64 of Encoded would change
a tab's clipboard token, never empty. draw mints one from a random draw infallibly, which the public door of Validated cannot do
a store key that orders as its text, the order the store ranges keys in, and every names the bounds of the whole store
the id peniko gives a registered font blob, a u64 that crate defines, private to the glyph atlas. Id holds a Uuid or a minted text alone
a glyph index as the shaper names it, a u16 the font defines
a latch a layer arms when its batch is rebuilt and its upload takes, private to the render module. No family holds a bool, and Flags is a set of named bits from a const table
a name composed for display alone: it converts to no String, so it is never stored (CHROME-080)
the character of a Key::Char, an ASCII letter lowercased at construction so two cases chord alike. No family of core holds a char
the leading spaces of a nested Markdown block, private to the writer
an anchor bounded to MAX_ANCHOR_LEN bytes where it is built, while serde reads any length. Encoded would refuse an anchor past MAX_LEN at decode, and writes base64
an id part: next ends at u32::MAX and never wraps or holds, so two mints never share a value
the counter half of a Loro ID, an i32 Loro defines
a Loro PeerID, a u64 Loro defines
sixteen lowercase hex digits built from a PeerID alone (AUTHOR-004)
a proleptic Gregorian year: any i64 is one, and the calendar arithmetic reads it
the alpha byte of a packed colour, which Rgba packs last
a colour packed 0x00RRGGBB whose top byte is zero, with channel operations
a colour packed 0xRRGGBBAA, with channel operations
associated data built and read within one seal or open: it crosses no thread, and Payload types bytes that do
the constant a fixture author picks: it pins the PeerID, the commit clock and the document id
points, finite and not negative. A decode refuses a negative value yet reads one past FontSize::MAX as the cap (CANVAS-088): Bounded refuses at both ends, and PrintLength<Pt> checks nothing
a media type as the browser names it, such as image/png, carried whole. The upload and schema code read and match it, so it is no Opaque, and it has no rule
an object store key the relay sorts to fetch each batch once, and its logs print whole through Display: Opaque has neither
the running state of an FNV-1a hash, private to the step fingerprint
a migration step fingerprint, only compared and printed as sixteen hex digits
frames per second of the page clock, measured and shown, never stored or sent: a rate, which no family holds
a Lamport stamp: many peers issue stamps and two may share a value, so it is no Seq
an HTTP status the relay answered, a u16 the HTTP standard defines
the one angle unit of the workspace, with to_degrees for a format that takes degrees
view pixels per millisecond, a rate no family holds: Px is a length and TimeSpan a span. Px::per writes it and ViewSpeed::over turns it back into a move
the field the chain hash or a keyless digest bounds with its length, borrowed for one call so a swap with the tail does not compile. Every byte family of core owns its bytes
the bytes the chain hash or a keyless digest reads after the bounded field, borrowed for one call so a swap with the head does not compile. Every byte family of core owns its bytes
the bytes one join signature covers, built in its own module alone, while Payload has a public constructor
an image identity the caller chooses, read for equality alone and never a hash of the pixels. Id holds a Uuid or a minted text alone
one axis of a wheel delta in the unit the browser reports: a pixel, a line or a page, known at run time. It is a length only once WheelDelta::to_px reads it, so no Px space fits
the name of an IndexedDB database, a literal a const holds. Every text family of core owns a String, which no const can build
an IndexedDB row key whose constructors name what the row belongs to, one per kind, which Opaque::new would open
a member id and an emoji joined by a space, built in one place (MURMURE-006)
the bytes Loro reads past the frame of one snapshot, borrowed for one parse with no copy. Every byte family of core owns its bytes
the raw sequence table of one framed snapshot, borrowed for one parse with no copy. Every byte family of core owns its bytes
an OPC part name: resolve, extension and relationships read and build it, operations no sibling shares, and two names compare in ASCII lower case as the conventions compare them

a meaning a foreign definition fixes: a relationship type URI of the OPC standard, borrowed from a 'static table a codec declares, matched under the transitional or the strict namespace by its last segment
a relationship type URI as a package spells it, which may name a type no codec follows, so it stays text and matches a RelKind by its last segment

a meaning a foreign definition fixes: a media type of the OpenDocument package, the document's type in its mimetype entry or a part's in the manifest, borrowed from a 'static table, as RelKind is for OPC
the Id of an OPC relationship, which an r: attribute of a part names: a key the package fixes and matches as text, with no rule to check
a writer under construction, not a value: the field is the buffer each call appends escaped XML to, and finish hands it out as the bytes of a package part
the gate depends on no workspace crate: a 1-based line number of the allowlist, for its messages
the gate depends on no workspace crate: one site as one line of six fields
the gate depends on no workspace crate: a number of sites the report counts
a container name, a tag and a tree id joined by a colon, built from the tree id alone
the 62 bits of a pinned id, a sequence that ends rather than wraps, private to the fixture ids
a ratio that is finite and above zero. Bounded holds it with the least positive f32 as MIN, but a crate outside core names no float constant of Bounded, and SINGLE and ONE_AND_HALF are const
the hex of a cross-reference record, with no Debug since it spells a label of the document
an open key of the mark registry: any text a newer client wrote, which the registry rules on by its root
a heading level as the document holds it, raw on purpose: an import may store one outside one to six
an IANA zone name with a const UTC, which Validated cannot build at compile time, and whose existence only the OOXML module's database decides
the bytes one signature covers, built in its own crate alone, while Payload has a public constructor
an identifier column as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from into an Id. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a core type
a stored public key as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from
a nullable sealed column as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from into its role type. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a core type
a nullable identifier column as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from into an Option of an Id. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a core type
a nullable sequence column as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from into an Option of a Seq, which refuses a negative value. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a core type
a nullable segment state column as sqlx reads it, decoded through try_from into an Option of a SegmentState. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a core type
the milliseconds left to a deadline as sqlx reads them, decoded into an Option of a Duration. The orphan rule bars an impl of sqlx::Type on a foreign type
payload bytes with a sqlx::Type impl, which the orphan rule bars on ambre_core::Payload

a generic family over a sealed slot marker, the Redis key doc:{id}:{slot}, with one door that builds it from a document id. Opaque::new would open any text, and Opaque prints the length alone where a log reads the key

a generic family over a sealed slot marker, the Redis key call:{id}:{slot}, with one door that builds it from a call id. Opaque::new would open any text, and a call is no document, so DocKey cannot hold it
the value a lock holder writes, which a release compares. Its one door is fresh, which Opaque::new would open
a generic family over a sealed kind, the bucket or a key prefix the relay reads from its settings. OpaqueKind is open, and Opaque prints the length alone where Debug prints the setting
one socket's key in the routing table of the hub. Its doors are new and the test door named, which Opaque::new would open
a Redis PubSub topic, one constructor per kind, which Opaque::new would open
the variance of the acknowledged rate in square bit/s, private to the delay estimator. No family of core holds a squared unit, and its one reading is the square root, a Bitrate of str0m
a relay route, or an object link without its query, as a log shows it. Target alone builds it, which Opaque::new would open

a generic family over a sealed kind, an address whose kinds each keep a constructor of their own, so no text a user typed becomes a route. Opaque::new admits any text, and Opaque prints the length alone where a log line reads the address
an opened payload that moves with no copy into the one role it reads, private to the pipeline. One of its roles, UpdateFrame, is no Payload, so into_role cannot carry it
bytes the seal alone builds, so a blob leaves the worker sealed (SYNC-049, ZK-001)
a transient frame of document plaintext that its owner wipes through UpdateFrame::wipe (ARCH-015). Its door is closed: from_bytes is pub(crate). A wipe cannot be inherent on Payload outside core
a board document borrowed for one Debug print, which prints its length alone (ZK-006). Every text family of core owns a String, and the print must not copy the document
a target id and a user id joined by a slash (TOILE-229)
the edit steps of a Myers path, signed for the diagonal arithmetic, private to the search
a signed diagonal of the Myers graph, private to the search
a signed offset into one text of the Myers graph, private to the search
a signed sum that moves by a VoteWeight and is read or printed, an arithmetic no family carries
the signed weight of one vote, any i32, which travels and is stored as the bare i32. No family holds a signed i32 that a sum reads
a CSS cursor value, a 'static keyword or inlined SVG borrowed with no allocation, or a value built at run time. Every text family of core owns a String
a log-zoom rate per pixel of wheel, private to the view
a signed place in a fill series, from a Delta of either axis: a fill line runs down rows or across columns, and Delta keeps the two axes apart
the root name of one sheet's container, joined in one place
a day that may run past either end of its month, as DATE reads it
an ASCII byte other than the double quote, CR and LF, checked where it is built
a signed step of decimal places, what one press of a control asks for. It moves a Bounded<Decimals> held at its bounds, an operation no family carries
the 51-character key of the cell maps, a row and a column joined in one place (trame-schema)
the words of the foreign XML parser, which a log may print: Validated and Opaque both mask or check a text this error neither checks nor hides

the decimal w:id of WordprocessingML, ST_DecimalNumber: the file fixes its width and its meaning, and it only matches a marker to its comment, its note or its tracked change. One generic over four markers, no count and no order
a writer under construction, not a value: the field is the buffer each call appends escaped XML to, and finish hands it out as the bytes of a part
